    • SSL_REVERSE_PROXIED

      public static final String SSL_REVERSE_PROXIED
      Value for PROPERTY_SSL_CONTEXT_SOURCE to indicate that this server is behind a reverse proxy. This enables the reverse proxy to handle SSL and communicate with this server via insecure Socket (but stll appear as a secure ServerHttpConnection).
      See Also:
